title: FPGA NES Emulator
description: A custom hardware implementation of an NES emulator targeting an FPGA board. This project handles low-level system logic, memory mapping, and rendering video output directly over DVI/HDMI from the FPGA.

title: 1S Mini Brushless Drone
description: Designed and programmed a custom 2.5-inch mini brushless drone. The project involved tuning 7500kv motors, implementing custom flight controller firmware, and fine-tuning PID loops for stable flight.

title: Switching Power Inverter
description: Built a DIY power inverter utilizing salvaged power components and a microcontroller. The system actively manages efficient DC-to-AC conversion cycles using custom control loops.
